question: In what sense is the supreme reality described as free from conceptual construction?
premises: The reality is called the best.
It is described as without conception.
It is described as devoid of manifold mental constructions.
inference: The supreme reality is the best, free from conception and devoid of manifold mental constructions.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of these descriptors depends on surrounding context.
plain_english: The best, without conception, devoid of manifold mental constructions.
